BEFORE THE FIRST BOX

Moving questions,
answered.

How much will my removal cost?
We quote each job individually. The price depends on the journey, items, access and time involved. Share a list and both postcodes for a quote.
Can you move a single item?
Yes, enquire about single-item collections and deliveries. Please include dimensions, photos if available, and details of access so we can confirm suitability.
Do you provide packing or take furniture apart?
Tell us what support you need when you enquire. Packing, materials and dismantling are not automatically included; we’ll confirm what can be arranged in your quote.
Can you handle very heavy or specialist items?
Please flag items such as pianos, safes, large appliances or especially fragile pieces before booking. We need to assess the job and confirm whether it is suitable for our service.
Do you offer waste clearance?
This service is for moving belongings. For rubbish disposal or waste clearance, ask us before making any plans; it is not included in a standard removal.
Can I add a clean to my move?
Yes. Ask for a combined move and clean, and tell us whether you need your old property, new property or both cleaned. We’ll discuss the timing and quote for the agreed services.
